## GPT-5.4 Pro API

GPT-5.4 Pro is a large language model by OpenAI, available on the Venice API as `openai-gpt-54-pro`. Requests are anonymized, so the provider never sees your identity.

GPT-5.4 Pro builds on GPT-5.4's unified architecture with enhanced reasoning for complex, high-stakes tasks. It provides a 1M+ token context window (922K input, 128K output) and supports text and image inputs.

### GPT-5.4 Pro API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `openai-gpt-54-pro` | Standard | Anonymized | $30.00 / $180 per 1M |

### GPT-5.4 Pro specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | OpenAI |
| Released | Mar 5, 2026 |
| Privacy | Anonymized |
| Status | Stable |
| Context window | 1M tokens |
| Max output | 128K tokens |
| Reasoning effort | none, medium, high, xhigh |

### How to use the GPT-5.4 Pro API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/responses` with `"model": "openai-gpt-54-pro"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/responses \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "openai-gpt-54-pro",
    "input": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences.",
    "reasoning": { "effort": "medium" }
  }'
```
